trigger: A readiness probe or query fails, times out, returns an authentication error, or contradicts registry expectations.
steps: classify missing executable vs authentication vs index unavailable vs query syntax vs stale local index
re-probe the same provider after repair
reselect only when the original provider gate is genuinely unavailable
outputs: repaired harness evidence or exact blocker
failureHandling: do not install dependencies, expose tokens, or weaken privacy gates
proofCeiling: failure diagnosis and owned repair only
